title: Quaid-e-Azam Muhammad Ali Jinnah
titleOriginal: قائد اعظم محمد علی جناح بانی پاکستان
takeaway: One wise and determined leader can wake up a whole nation.
scene: This is the first of several tributes in the book to people the poet admired. It honours Muhammad Ali Jinnah, the founder of Pakistan, known as Quaid-e-Azam, 'the Great Leader'.

original: حکمت فہم فراست دے نال جہنے مسلم قوم دی بدل تقدیر دتی
سوچاں اچیاں جوش تے نال جذبے نویں ولولے نوں تنویر دتی
transliteration: Hikmat fehm firaasat de naal jihne Muslim qaum di badal taqdeer ditti
Sochaan uchiyaan josh te naal jazbe naveen valvale nu tanveer ditti
translation: With wisdom, understanding and insight, he changed the destiny of the Muslim nation.
With high ideals, passion and feeling, he lit up a new enthusiasm.
couplets.story: Jinnah used wisdom and clear thinking to change the future of the Muslims of the subcontinent. He gave people big ideas and filled them with fresh energy.

original: انکھ مان تران تے شان دتی نویں سر یوں بخش توقیر دتی
ایہہ قوم سی خاک در خاک ہوئی کر کیمیا گر اکسیر دتی
transliteration: Ankh maan taraan te shaan ditti, naveen siryon bakhsh tauqeer ditti
Eh qaum si khaak dar khaak hoi, kar kimiyaagar akseer ditti
translation: He gave us self-respect, pride, strength and dignity, and honour all over again.
This nation had been ground into the dust; like an alchemist, he gave it the magic elixir.
couplets.story: He gave people back their self-respect and dignity. The nation had been beaten down into the dust, and he was like an alchemist who turns dust into gold.

original: اتحاد تنظیم یقین محکم ساڈے واسطے زندہ پیغام اوہدا
ایسے واسطے احمدؔ میں آکھداہاں حشر تیک رہنا زندہ نام اوہدا
transliteration: Ittehaad, tanzeem, yaqeen-e-muhkam saade vaaste zinda paighaam ohda
Ise vaaste Ahmad main aakhda haan, hashr teek rehna zinda naam ohda
translation: Unity, discipline and firm faith: his message is alive for us.
That's why, Ahmad, I say his name will live until Judgment Day.
couplets.story: His motto was 'Unity, Faith, Discipline', and that message is still alive. That's why the poet says Jinnah's name will be remembered until the end of time.

original: گلوں طوق غلامی دا لاہن خاطر ستی قوم نوں فیر جگا دتا
کڑی کڑی غلامی دی توڑنے لئی ہمت جرأت دا سبق پڑھا دتا
transliteration: Galon tauq ghulaami da laahan khaatir sutti qaum nu pher jaga ditta
Kari kari ghulaami di torne layi himmat jur'at da sabaq parha ditta
translation: To take the collar of slavery off our necks, he woke the sleeping nation again.
To break every link of the chain of slavery, he taught the lesson of courage and boldness.
couplets.story: People were living as if wearing a slave's collar under foreign rule. Jinnah woke them up and taught them to be brave enough to break every link of that chain.

original: زندہ قوماں وانگوں زندہ رہن والا اپنی قوم نوں ڈھب سکھا دتا
اوس مرد قلندر دے درس احمدؔ چڑیاں تائیں شہباز بنا دتا
transliteration: Zinda qaumaan vaangon zinda rehan vaala apni qaum nu dhab sikha ditta
Os mard-e-qalandar de dars Ahmad chiriyaan taaeen shahbaaz bana ditta
translation: He taught his nation how to live like a living, free nation.
Ahmad, that fearless man's lessons turned sparrows into royal falcons.
couplets.story: He taught his people how to live with pride, like a free nation. The poet ends with a great image: Jinnah's lessons turned little sparrows into mighty falcons.

deeper: This is a tribute, not a mystical poem, but it uses spiritual language. 'Mard-e-qalandar', the fearless holy man who cares nothing for worldly approval, is a title of honour from Sufi tradition. 'Turning sparrows into falcons' echoes a famous Sikh line about Guru Gobind Singh, well known across Punjab. It also recalls Allama Iqbal's falcon (shahbaz), the symbol of a free and lofty soul.
why: It gives readers a quick picture of why Jinnah is so respected in Pakistan, and introduces his famous motto.
prompt: Who is someone, past or present, who made people braver just by leading them?
notes: The 'sparrows into falcons' image is famous across Punjab from the Sikh tradition; here it is applied to Jinnah.
